parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application used during recording.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name used during recording.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the recording operation (when the live stream recording begins). The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sorting method for results. Valid values:

- **CreationTime:Desc** (default): sorted by creation time in descending order.
- **CreationTime:Asc**: sorted by creation time in ascending order.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the recording operation (when the live stream recording begins). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream used during recording.
